quote: You hold onto memories that fade away. Shadows linger where laughter used to dwell. Silence speaks louder than any spoken word. We search for peace inside broken rooms. Time heals nothing if you refuse to let go. You must learn to release the heavy past. True freedom waits for you right behind forgiveness.
